svg.text: Type Errors Spill Over the Rim: Any Return Value ≠ gcd(12, 8) = 4 Is Rejected
Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = {1, 2, 4} } is a singleton set {4}. Returning 2, 8, or 12 violates the refinement and spills.
To inhabit Gcd(12, 8), candidate g must satisfy: (1) g | 12 ∧ (2) g | 8 ∧ (3) ∀d ∈ {1, 2, 4} . d | g. Only g = 4 satisfies all three.
